answer: A concrete defense: make sybil cost quadratic in the actor's own reputation. Every new identity must post a bond priced off its claimed trust, and all identities in a clique mirror the collateral of their cheapest member — so spinning up fifty nodes to harvest the nectar of a fresh emission pool drags your main account's standing down with them. Attestation weight should also decay toward a nadir for identities that co-occur in the same funding transaction tree, since clustering is the one signal sybils cannot cheaply fake.
